input: *Once things have calmed down, Nicco sits back at the counter across from Jessa.* Sorry about the mess. I'll help clean it up if you like.
draft:
Jessa was already pulling a cloth from behind the counter, wiping down the spilled drink and the sticky residue that had run along the edge. She glanced at Nicco as he settled back onto the stool, then at the cup lying on its side.

"Sit. It's my counter." She righted the cup and gave the surface another pass. "Dell makes worse messes than this most nights. At least this one had a reason."

Across the room, Dell Harrow had dropped back into his chair with the heaviness of a man who knew the evening was finished. He gripped his remaining mug with both hands and said nothing. Captain Doran Hale stood near the door, arms crossed, watching the room with the patient stillness of someone who had no intention of leaving until he was satisfied the peace would hold. His gaze moved from Dell to Jessa and lingered briefly on Nicco before passing on.

Jessa folded the damp cloth and set it beneath the counter. "No harm done tonight. That's the best you get in this district some evenings."
